messages:
olivia park: opened a small PR to add an "autoscale examples" subsection that shows policy YAML + expected behavior during reclaim events. link: https://git/repo/pulls/4992

david chen: nice. can we make one example for bursty inference vs steady throughput? ops often asks for the burst case.

jamal ford: also add an isolation note: when peak reclaim happens, prefer wording 'best-effort throttling' not 'downtime' per legal.

olivia park: good call. i'll update wording. adding a tiny table that maps policy -> tenant effect.

rachel kim: pls include a python SDK snippet for creating the policy programmatically. folks copy that into quickstarts.

```python
# create autoscale policy
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
policy = c.create_autoscale_policy(
    name="burst-optimized",
    min_replicas=1,
    max_replicas=10,
    reclaim_priority="low"
)
print(policy.id)
```

olivia park: added the snippet. note: SDK requirement >= 0.10.0 for reclaim_priority enum.

docs-bot: Lint: missing cross-link to /handbook/dedicated/autoscale.md and broken link detected: /handbook/dedicated/old-schema.md (404). Suggest replacing with /handbook/dedicated/migration.md#legacy-fields

david chen: thanks docs-bot. I found another broken anchor in the SLA section, file a follow-up?

jamal ford: ops requested a short rollback snippet in the migration section. pasted CLI rollback command in the PR comments.

```bash
# rollback migration from backup.yaml
redwoodctl dedicated restore-tenant --backup backup.yaml
```

rachel kim: small nit: in the isolation note, quantify "short" -> "under 2 minutes" if that's conservative. ops team ok with that?

jamal ford: ops confirmed. we'll keep conservative number: "transient throttling under 2 minutes for small pools"

olivia park: staging deploy queued. tagging @david chen for editorial, @rachel kim for SDK quickstart sync.

staging-bot: deploy started: docs-staging -> /handbook/dedicated at 1823457400 by olivia park

david chen: will run a quick smoke: create a small tenant, apply policy, then simulate reclaim. report back here.

rachel kim: i'll update quickstarts after staging is live, small PR to update SDK version notes.

olivia park: merging after smoke test + one more review. thanks all.

david chen: smoke test done: burst policy scaled to 6 nodes, observed ~45s of elevated throttling when reclaim simulated. no errors.

jamal ford: perfect. closing follow-up issues: broken link fix + migration anchor update. :white_check_mark:
